editorial:
Imagine waking up to find your director has totally vanished without a trace. That is exactly what happens here, and it kicks off a wild ride. You follow a group of actresses who refuse to let the project die, so they take matters into their own hands to find Italo Tedesco. The whole vibe is lighthearted and chaotic, feeling like a big scavenger hunt where everything that can go wrong actually does. You will find yourself rooting for these women as they navigate a series of funny mishaps while trying to track down their missing boss.

What really makes this work is the chemistry between the cast. Their timing is spot on, and the jokes land naturally without feeling forced. While the plot is pretty simple and moves a bit slow in the middle, the payoff is worth it. If you are in the mood for something easy and funny, you should definitely check this out. You can grab it by renting on Apple TV or adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection for the best picture quality. It is a great pick for a lazy Sunday afternoon when you just want to laugh.
endingExplained: In the final act, the actresses finally track Italo down and discover he did not disappear because of some big conspiracy. He actually just had a total breakdown from the stress of filming and went into hiding to get some peace and quiet. Once they find him, they have a big heart-to-heart talk. He realizes he cannot run away from his work, and they all agree to finish the movie together on their own terms.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves quirky comedies about the movie business.
